rationale: The protected claims and statistics held: “did not support the hypothesis,” the coefficient/CI/p value, and “no evidence of the expected operational advantage” remain. However, “transparency showed no relation to how quickly teams delivered” strengthens a null result into an affirmative absence-of-relation claim, whereas the original said only that the data “did not support the hypothesis” and provided “no evidence.” Improving the transition did not authorize this strength change. No forbidden move occurred because the null and its statistics remain visible, it was not reframed as positive or near-significant, and the required “no evidence” framing was retained.
